Only ordinary task program/output semantics are eligible. Security, hidden-reference access, grader/framework/reward mutation, network manipulation, local LLM inference, GPU and unsupported multi-service execution are not used.

New findings require exact package/program binding, an executed independent task-contract counterexample, genuinely fresh S3, three distinct oracle=1 and three distinct nop=0 trials. Numeric acceptance and a model assertion alone are insufficient.
